title: The big fppf site
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $\mathit{Sch}_{fppf}$ be a big fppf site containing $S$, its category of schemes chosen within the bound of the size convention [def-weil-size-convention] (Stacks, Topologies, Definition 34.7.8, Tag [021S](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/021S)). The *big fppf site of $S$* is the site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] $(\mathit{Sch}/S)_{fppf}=\mathit{Sch}_{fppf}/S$: its objects are the schemes $T\to S$ of $\mathit{Sch}_{fppf}$ over $S$, its morphisms are the $S$-morphisms, and its coverings are the families $\{f_i:T_i\to T\}_{i\in I}$ such that every $f_i$ is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] (the notions of [def-pc-morphism-conventions]) and the family is jointly surjective, $T=\bigcup_{i\in I}f_i(T_i)$. Such a family is an *fppf covering* of $T$ (Stacks Tag [021L](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/021L)).
